body: Fixed in 5a181b6f6. Invalid primary_display_mode values now fall back to structured_native when structured content is available, otherwise fallback_explanation; added regression coverage for source_image_only inputs so they never become learner-facing primary display.

Fixed in 5a181b6f6. validatePostAttemptSourceImageEvidencePosture now reports explicit fail-closed diagnostics for non-record options, missing/non-object postureArtifact or upstream, non-array posture rows/fixtures, and malformed upstream readModel rows; malformed-input tests now assert those error codes.
